defs.meaning: 使想起，使回忆；再次唤醒

examples.en: It is time to reawaken this giant.
examples.zh: 现在是时候重新唤醒这个巨人了。

examples.en: And while life challenges can reawaken some aspect of the trauma its affects grows less powerful with time.
examples.zh: 当生活的挑战能够唤醒创伤的某个方面时，它的效果会随时间而变弱。
